ck_hr_employee_scopes_dates.name: ck_hr_employee_scopes_dates
ck_hr_employee_scopes_dates.value: length("hr_employee_scopes"."valid_from") = 10 AND ("hr_employee_scopes"."valid_to" IS NULL OR (length("hr_employee_scopes"."valid_to") = 10 AND "hr_employee_scopes"."valid_to" > "hr_employee_scopes"."valid_from"))

ck_hr_employments_dates.name: ck_hr_employments_dates
ck_hr_employments_dates.value: length("hr_employments"."hired_on") = 10 AND length("hr_employments"."seniority_start_on") = 10 AND ("hr_employments"."ended_on" IS NULL OR (length("hr_employments"."ended_on") = 10 AND "hr_employments"."ended_on" > "hr_employments"."hired_on")) AND "hr_employments"."seniority_start_on" <= "hr_employments"."hired_on"

ck_hr_attendance_location_schedules_peri.name: ck_hr_attendance_location_schedules_period
ck_hr_attendance_location_schedules_peri.value: "hr_attendance_location_schedules"."is_rest_day" = 1 OR ("hr_attendance_location_schedules"."start_minute" IS NOT NULL AND "hr_attendance_location_schedules"."end_minute" IS NOT NULL AND "hr_attendance_location_schedules"."end_minute" > "hr_attendance_location_schedules"."start_minute")

ck_hr_attendance_locations_geo_pair.name: ck_hr_attendance_locations_geo_pair
ck_hr_attendance_locations_geo_pair.value: ("hr_attendance_locations"."geolocation_required" = 0) OR ("hr_attendance_locations"."latitude_e7" IS NOT NULL AND "hr_attendance_locations"."longitude_e7" IS NOT NULL)

ck_hr_clock_events_coordinate_pair.name: ck_hr_clock_events_coordinate_pair
ck_hr_clock_events_coordinate_pair.value: ("hr_clock_events"."latitude_e7" IS NULL AND "hr_clock_events"."longitude_e7" IS NULL) OR ("hr_clock_events"."latitude_e7" IS NOT NULL AND "hr_clock_events"."longitude_e7" IS NOT NULL)

ck_hr_insurance_contribution_rules_rate.name: ck_hr_insurance_contribution_rules_rate
ck_hr_insurance_contribution_rules_rate.value: "hr_insurance_contribution_rules"."employee_rate_ppm" BETWEEN 0 AND 1000000 AND "hr_insurance_contribution_rules"."employer_rate_ppm" BETWEEN 0 AND 1000000 AND "hr_insurance_contribution_rules"."dependent_rate_ppm" BETWEEN 0 AND 1000000

ck_hr_overtime_actual_pair.name: ck_hr_overtime_actual_pair
ck_hr_overtime_actual_pair.value: ("hr_overtime_requests"."actual_start" IS NULL AND "hr_overtime_requests"."actual_end" IS NULL) OR ("hr_overtime_requests"."actual_start" IS NOT NULL AND "hr_overtime_requests"."actual_end" IS NOT NULL AND "hr_overtime_requests"."actual_end" > "hr_overtime_requests"."actual_start")

ck_hr_special_workday_assignments_target.name: ck_hr_special_workday_assignments_target
ck_hr_special_workday_assignments_target.value: ("hr_special_workday_assignments"."employment_id" IS NOT NULL AND "hr_special_workday_assignments"."worker_id" IS NULL) OR ("hr_special_workday_assignments"."employment_id" IS NULL AND "hr_special_workday_assignments"."worker_id" IS NOT NULL)

ck_hr_special_workday_versions_wage.name: ck_hr_special_workday_versions_wage
ck_hr_special_workday_versions_wage.value: ("hr_special_workday_rule_versions"."wage_kind" = 'fixed_hourly' AND "hr_special_workday_rule_versions"."fixed_amount_minor" IS NOT NULL AND "hr_special_workday_rule_versions"."fixed_amount_minor" >= 0 AND "hr_special_workday_rule_versions"."multiplier_ppm" IS NULL) OR ("hr_special_workday_rule_versions"."wage_kind" = 'multiplier' AND "hr_special_workday_rule_versions"."fixed_amount_minor" IS NULL AND "hr_special_workday_rule_versions"."multiplier_ppm" IS NOT NULL AND "hr_special_workday_rule_versions"."multiplier_ppm" >= 0)

ck_hr_payroll_periods_dates.name: ck_hr_payroll_periods_dates
ck_hr_payroll_periods_dates.value: length("hr_payroll_periods"."attendance_start") = 10 AND length("hr_payroll_periods"."attendance_end") = 10 AND "hr_payroll_periods"."attendance_end" > "hr_payroll_periods"."attendance_start" AND ("hr_payroll_periods"."pay_date" IS NULL OR length("hr_payroll_periods"."pay_date") = 10)
